cim_eredeti: ESMO Launches a New Peer-Reviewed Journal Dedicated to Artificial Intelligence in Oncology
szoveg_eredeti:
ESMO – European Society for Medical Oncology shared on LinkedIn:

“ESMO has launched ESMO Artificial Intelligence and Oncology, a new peer-reviewed journal dedicated to the application of artificial intelligence across cancer research and care.

The journal will publish original research, reviews, editorials, perspectives, news and educational content addressing the transformation of oncology through AI.

Covering topics ranging from pathology and molecular profiling to imaging, from drug development to clinical decision support, from healthcare workflows to health economics, regulation and education, ESMO Artificial Intelligence and Oncology aims to support the evaluation, validation and implementation of AI applications in cancer care.

Under the leadership of Editor-in-Chief Jakob Nikolas Kather, the journal will provide a platform for clinically relevant research while promoting methodological rigour, transparency and multidisciplinary collaboration.”
